text:
james_m: Packaging window tonight for Private/VPC release v1.4.3. Plan: build installer + images, sign, upload to staging bucket, then push manifest canary at 22:00 PT. Need quick sign-off on cosign key rotation and checksum publishing. @olivia_p can you confirm release note blurb for customers?

deploy-bot: build-pack-1.4.3 triggered by @james_m — job queued, ETA ~30m. :package:

olivia_p: Ack. I'll draft notes. Quick question — are we rotating the cosign key or reusing existing HSM key? export-control checklist?

maya_s: We need to rotate cosign key to v2 (policy requires rotation every 6 months). I can do rotation tonight prior to signing, but we must update installer manifest KMS ARN and the key thumbprint in the release metadata. Change window 22:00-23:30 PT works for infra.

kevin_r: Rollback plan? If the new installer causes failures, can we re-point customers to the previous manifest tag without manual steps? Need automated fallback option.

james_m: Rollback plan: publish new manifest with canary flag to selected orgs (canary set), wait 30m. If we hit abort criteria we'll flip the active-manifest pointer in S3 to prior tag (automated via deploy-runbook). Also we'll keep old images pinned with tag stable-1.4.2 for at least 48h.

olivia_p: Release notes draft (short): "v1.4.3: security key rotation, packaging fixes for VPC private installer, improved image pullback handling. Customers using airgapped installs: ensure your ops team has new cosign thumbprint and checksum." Will post full notes to docs site after canary green.

sec-bot: Security review: pending HSM key rotation confirmation. Must include KMS ARN update and audit entry for rotation. Approve conditional on audit log present and checksum published to signed_manifest.json.

deploy-bot: build-pack-1.4.3 completed. Artifacts uploaded to s3://private-staging/v1.4.3/installer.tar.gz

maya_s: Preflight checks done. Commands used:
```
sha256sum installer.tar.gz
cosign verify-blob --key ksm://cosign/v2 signer.sig installer.tar.gz
```
sha256: 9f8b3c2a7d... (redacted) — cosign verification OK.

kevin_r: Starting canary push to 5 orgs now (canary-group IDs: 12,14,19,22,30). Monitoring hooks: latency, error-rate, manifest-apply failures. Abort criteria: >3% error-rate or >200ms median latency spike for 10m.

james_m: Noted. Support playbook updated and attached to the release thread. Oncall SREs notified. :eyes:

olivia_p: Posting release note to private-customers channel and adding FAQ about key thumbprint rotation.

sec-bot: Audit log entry created for key rotation request id=KR-2024-1109-03. Approved for release after canary.

deploy-bot: canary-push started at 2024-11-12T22:05:12Z for manifest v1.4.3-canary

maya_s: Observability: tailing installer logs, no manifest-apply errors seen so far. latency trend steady.

kevin_r: Canary 15m mark — error-rate 0.6%, latency +10ms. Continuing.

james_m: If all green at 30m I'll promote to full rollout during the window. If we hit abort I'll flip the manifest pointer and open rollback incident.

deploy-bot: canary complete (30m). conditions met. proceeding with staged promotion. :shipit:

olivia_p: Pushed release notes and customer email. Support ready. :thumbsup:

kevin_r: Promotion started. Will monitor next 60m closely.

maya_s: Post-release checklist: update docs with new cosign thumbprint, rotate staging key used in test infra, schedule HSM rotation confirmation with sec team tomorrow.

james_m: Closing packaging thread — will file final release artifact report and deliver signed_manifest.json to archives. Thanks team!
